task.text: Purchase request from the Production department: buy 30 coils of 20mm mooring rope (item ID ITM-ROPE-20) from Arabian Sea Marine Stores (supplier ID SUP-ARBS) at the catalogue price of PKR 9,500 per coil, for a total of PKR 285,000.

policies.title: Spending approval threshold
policies.text: Any purchase with a total above PKR 200,000 must be approved through the approval process before an order is placed. Purchases of exactly PKR 200,000 or less do not need approval.

policies.title: Restricted supplier list
policies.text: Suppliers on the restricted supplier list (Thar Hardware Co.) are under compliance review. Every order from a restricted supplier must be approved through the approval process, whatever the amount.
